text: FAA guidance supports trying to reestablish the control link and, if unsuccessful, initiating emergency/contingency procedures and discontinuing flight until inspection. The Autel EVO Max 4N manual states the C2 link loss triggers a configurable signal loss action, with the drone slowing, hovering, and executing the Signal Lost behavior if the disconnection persists beyond the threshold (and control can return if the link is restored within 10 seconds). The incident reports (unverified) claim loss of control after takeoff, continued flight away from the operator, failed Return To Home attempts, and non-recovery of the UAS.
